metric_definitions.js_divergence_to_pooled_nats: Jensen-Shannon divergence from the pooled client distribution, using natural logarithms.
metric_definitions.observed_class_imbalance_ratio: largest non-zero class count / smallest non-zero class count; missing classes are excluded and reported by missing_class_rate.
metric_definitions.pooled_distribution_scope: deterministic_local_training_subsets; client validation and global test excluded.

content.client_training_class_counts_scope: deterministic_local_training_subsets; validation and global test excluded

feature_encoder.schema_fit_scope: shared header of every source split; a categorical column is rejected before any row is materialised

source_partition.pooled_row_order: concatenation of the source client CSVs in ascending client id, each file in its original row order
